purpose: Give each ordered row a distinct sequential position
inputs: All result rows ordered by score descending, then unique ID
resultOrEffect: Integer position starting at 1; no stored-row mutation

purpose: Assign consecutive ranks to tied score groups
inputs: All result rows ordered by score descending, without ID tie-breaker
resultOrEffect: Integer rank starting at 1; equal scores share one rank, no gaps
syntaxBreakdown: Empty parentheses; OVER supplies peer ordering, AS level labels the returned rank.
